geography: Global listings selected by the ETF universe register
access_description: Founder-only server-side reads of daily Japanese candles. The key stays in a gitignored env file and is sent only to api.tradingviewapi.com.
auth_requirement: Authorization Bearer key on the Basic plan. 200 requests a month and 2 a second on the published plan table. This import hard-stops at 60.
conditions: Private retention for the account holder is permitted by the terms read on 3 November 2026. Do not show the series to other signed-in users. Do not treat the vendor as an exchange licence. Saxo bars stay out of this table.
revision_behaviour: A later response for the same session appends a new revision only when the close or adjustment definition changes. An identical close is skipped.
unresolved_questions: Exchange and upstream display rules can be stricter than the API terms. Redistribution to other Aqil users and commercial publication were not cleared. The dividends adjustment is not documented as a total-return index.
evidence_note: Terms last updated 20 August 2026, section 5, permit display, redistribution inside the customer's own product, and caching and forwarding, subject to plan quota. Section 6 says this is not an exchange licence and a separate legal review is required before showing data to paying subscribers. Section 7 gives no indemnification. Docs read the same day describe GET /api/price as the candlestick route, type Japanese, and adjustment splits or dividends.
